source.name: WOGCC well header download, as published by the Wyoming State Geological Survey (January 3, 2025)

at_risk.definition: WOGCC status SI (shut in) or TA (temporarily abandoned), with an operator named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked yet: the state file is the only operator source found so far. The WSGS copy of WOGCC data is dated January 3, 2025.
notes: Status codes used: PO producing oil, PG producing gas, AI active injection, SI shut in, TA temporarily abandoned, PA plugged and abandoned.
